Definition of Proficiency (Score: 4-5): Needle enters perpendicular to the adventitia; follows the curvature of the needle.
Common Errors (Score: 1-2): "Skating" on the vessel surface; oblique entry causing trauma.

Definition of Proficiency (Score: 4-5): Smooth transfer from the driver to forceps without dropping or excessive re-grasping.
Common Errors (Score: 1-2): Multiple attempts to grasp the needle; "fishing" for the needle tip.

Definition of Proficiency (Score: 4-5): Uniform distance between bites (standardly 1-2mm) and consistent depth.
Common Errors (Score: 1-2): Irregular spacing leading to potential leaks or "pursing" of the suture line.

Definition of Proficiency (Score: 4-5): Tension is consistent; edges are approximated without strangulation or gaps.
Common Errors (Score: 1-2): Loose loops or excessive force causing the vessel wall to tear (cheese-wiring).

Definition of Proficiency (Score: 4-5): Flat square knots; maintained tension on the first throw; minimum of 3-4 throws.
Minimal use of forceps on the intima; vessel held by adventitia only.
Common Errors (Score: 1-2): Frequent grasping of the intima; crushing the vessel wall with forceps.
